candidates.description: This feature vector represents common subword tokens and fragments from the Hindi Devanagari script.
This feature vector is sensitive to common character n-grams and subword fragments found in Hindi text.
This feature vector represents common Hindi words and morphological suffixes.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters and consonant-vowel conjuncts, particularly focusing on the letter 'प' (pa).
This vector represents common Hindi vowel signs and consonant conjuncts used in word formation.
This vector is related to Hindi vowel matras followed by punctuation marks.
This vector is related to Hindi nasalization diacritics and anusvara vowel modifiers.
This vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Hindi text.
This vector represents common initial character sequences and prefixes in Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates on Hindi verb inflections and suffixes that encode tense, gender, and number agreement.
